answer: An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 3 such diverse attestations are required. Buying 3 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the farming party's cost, and each one has to keep a quartz record clean through the atlas check. Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce a spiral signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. That is 19 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
